name: code-editor
purpose: An editable code surface with line numbers, diagnostics and a read-only and a diff mode. It is a plain-text editor first: a monospace textarea with a line-number gutter that works on the server, without JavaScript and on any device. When the app passes a `loader` (for example `() => import('monaco-editor')`), Monaco is loaded lazily, painted with the design tokens and takes over the same value, markers and options; until it loads, or if it fails, the plain editor stays in place. It differs from `code-block`, which only shows code.
useWhen: Editing a function, a script, a SQL query, a JSON or YAML document inside the product.
Showing the change between two versions of code side by side (diff mode), for example before a deploy or a revert.
Code that the server validates: the diagnostics come back as `markers` and show on their lines and in a list.
A read-only view of code that still needs the editor's navigation (find, folding) once Monaco is loaded.
avoidWhen: Showing a snippet to copy, with tabs and a file name → use `code-block`.
A one-line value such as a header, a regex or a path → use `input` inside a `field`.
Free prose or a description → use `textarea`.
A stream of log lines → use `log-view`.
A form generated from a JSON schema → use `schema-form` (the arguments tab of a function pairs both).
related: code-block` — read-only snippets with copy; same syntax colour tokens.
textarea` — plain multi-line text; the fallback editor is built in its spirit but keeps code typography and a gutter.
field` — wraps the editor with a label, a description and an error; the editor reads id, `aria-describedby`, invalid and disabled from it.
toggle-group` — the document switch (Code / Arguments) placed in the `toolbar` slot.
log-view` — output of a run next to the editor.
bestPractices: Wrap it in a `Field` with a visible label, or give it an `ariaLabel`; the label names the textarea and the Monaco editor.
Pass `loader` from the app (`() => import('monaco-editor')`) so Monaco is code-split and never part of the WebKit bundle; set up Monaco's workers in that module.
Send server diagnostics as `markers` with 1-based lines; keep each message one sentence.
Give the editor a fixed `height`, or `fill` inside a flex column that has its own height; never let it grow with the content.
Use `readonly` for code the user may read and select but not change; use `disabled` only when the whole form is locked.
In diff mode, `original` is the left side and `v-model` the right side; keep the right side editable only when the change can still be edited.

props.name: language
props.doc: Monaco language id (`javascript`, `typescript`, `json`, `sql`, `lua`, `yaml`…). The fallback ignores it.

props.name: loader
props.doc: Loads Monaco lazily; without it the plain editor is the editor.

props.name: readonly
props.doc: The code can be read, selected and copied but not changed.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Locks the editor; it leaves the tab order.

props.name: invalid
props.doc: Paints the danger border; also set by a surrounding `Field`.

props.name: diff
props.doc: Shows `original` beside the value as a side-by-side diff.

props.name: original
props.doc: The left side of the diff.

props.name: markers
props.doc: Diagnostics shown on their lines and in the problems list.

props.name: height
props.doc: CSS height of the editing area.

props.name: fill
props.doc: Fills a flex column instead of using `height`.

props.name: path
props.doc: Model path for Monaco language services (`index.ts`, `args.json`).

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name when no `Field` label names it. Empty uses the locale catalog.

events.name: ready
events.notes: Monaco mounted; the payload is the editor instance (for actions).

events.name: load-error
events.notes: The loader rejected; the plain editor stays.

slots.name: toolbar
slots.notes: A bar above the editing area: a document switch, the file name, a Format or Run action.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import CodeEditor from '@aziontech/webkit/code-editor'
  import Field from '@aziontech/webkit/field'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const code = ref(`export default async function handler(request) {
  const url = new URL(request.url)
  const name = url.searchParams.get('name')
  return new Response(\`Hello, \${name}\`)
}
`)

  const markers = [
    { line: 3, severity: 'warning', message: 'name can be null; give it a default value.' },
    { line: 4, severity: 'info', message: 'Set a Content-Type header on the response.' }
  ]
</script>

<template>
  <Field>
    <Field.Label>Function code</Field.Label>
    <CodeEditor
      v-model="code"
      language="javascript"
      :markers="markers"
      height="14rem"
    />
    <Field.Description>Runs on every request that reaches this function.</Field.Description>
  </Field>
</template>

examples.name: Diff
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import CodeEditor from '@aziontech/webkit/code-editor'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const original = `{
  "cache": {
    "ttl": 60,
    "bypass": false
  }
}
`

  const next = ref(`{
  "cache": {
    "ttl": 300,
    "bypass": false,
    "stale": true
  }
}
`)
</script>

<template>
  <CodeEditor
    v-model="next"
    :original="original"
    language="json"
    diff
    height="12rem"
    aria-label="Cache settings"
  />
</template>

examples.name: ReadOnly
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import CodeEditor from '@aziontech/webkit/code-editor'

  const query = `SELECT country, count(*) AS requests
FROM events
WHERE status >= 500
GROUP BY country
ORDER BY requests DESC
LIMIT 10;
`
</script>

<template>
  <CodeEditor
    :model-value="query"
    language="sql"
    readonly
    height="10rem"
    aria-label="Saved query"
  />
</template>
